It is a fairly flat, wide pool seen from above, but it has a back rim, a lava surface and a front rim, so it reads as three-quarter rather than a flat slab.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small lava pool, not a tree, so it is not the same kind as the references (canopy and trunk plants). It is also under one tile wide, so the per-tile tone count of 12 is a rough guide only. By eye, the molten core has about 4 orange/yellow steps with some grain, which is decent. The rock rim is a dark charcoal with almost no tint, and 100% of its dark edge pixels are near-neutral. The references have 0% neutral edges, with outlines in dark green or brown. This is the neutral black outline of the sticker look, where Beodeul uses a dark tone of the adjacent material. The rim rock is flat and dark, with few highlight steps and little per-stone shading. The overall ramp is shallower than the roughly 6 steps and 20-30 tones of the richer reference tree. Fails on the near-black outline and the shallow rock shading.
